Refit a PLSR/PCR model after selecting observations

Source: R/refit.R
refit.Rd

Refit an existing mvr model after selecting observations from the training set. The selection can be interpreted either negatively (exclude selected observations) or positively (keep only selected observations).

Usage

refit(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mvr'
refit(object, selection = NULL, exclude = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

object

an object to refit.

...

additional arguments passed to methods.

selection

character or numeric vector identifying selected observations. Values are matched against row names in the model frame used for fitting.

exclude

logical. If TRUE (default), selected observations are removed before refitting. If FALSE, only selected observations are kept.

Value

A refitted model object.

Examples

data(yarn)
mod <- plsr(density ~ NIR, ncomp = 6, data = yarn)
ids <- rownames(model.frame(mod))[1:5]
mod_excluded <- refit(mod, selection = ids, exclude = TRUE)
mod_included <- refit(mod, selection = ids, exclude = FALSE)
#> Warning: `ncomp` reduced to 4 for refit data.
